links.outcome: AI literacy, acceptance, and attitudes after responsible-use ChatGPT training
links.effect: Paired differences (pre-test minus post-test): literacy -1.56 (p = 0.351), acceptance -4.31 (p = 0.008), and attitudes -8.22 (p < 0.001). Training covered capabilities, limitations, prompting, and ethical use; no comparator group.
links.quote: Quantitatively, AI literacy showed only a small and non-significant pre-post change, whereas AI acceptance and attitudes towards AI showed statistically significant increases.

links.effect: AI acceptance scores showed a statistically significant increase after the training (p = 0.008).
links.quote: On the other hand, a statistically significant increase was observed in the AI Acceptance scores after the training ( p = 0.008).
